Bento for macOS 0.2.16
What’s new
- Change Dock hiding, menu-bar hiding, and native snapping while Bento is running. Turning an option off restores its previous macOS setting immediately. - Adjust window gaps and desktop margins live, with matching grabber positions. Rapid edits are combined, and updates wait until a window drag ends. - Preserve edited slots when available desktop space changes. - Calculate a fitting arrangement for a new app before minimizing another app when an edited layout is too restrictive. - Adapt to persistent app size changes, protect the focused or newly opened app, and stop repeating unchanged failed arrangements. - Prevent Bento settings clicks and slider drags from grabbing windows underneath the settings panel.
